title: Grateful Dead Live at Charlotte Coliseum on 1989-10-22
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp > Adobe Audition CC2015 > Samplitude Pro X4 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Crisp ultramatrix capture of a tasty first set where Jerry sounds especially happy.
ai_review.review: The matrix recording is praised for its crisp, clear sound, making the music easy to enjoy. Reviewers note a "tasty" first set and highlight Jerry Garcia's upbeat playing, though no specific songs are singled out. Overall it’s a solid listening experience with good technical quality but nothing extraordinary.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate‑rated review; the show is described positively but without standout moments, while the recording is noted as crisp, leading to an average combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review mentions "crisp sound," indicating clear and well‑balanced audio despite being a matrix source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as "tasty" with good energy; no specific criticisms noted.
